summary: Verified the repair-world-locations fix on preview across web + mobile + API. All 6 previously-empty cities (ammeonon/amberport, ammeonon/duncroft, dhor-kuldor/emberhold, dhor-kuldor/frosthold, dhor-kuldor/stonehaven, veiled-realms/rakesh) now show exactly 4 starter locations (Gate, Market Row, Town Square, Hearth). No regression on populated cities (ammeonon/wymroost still returns 36 locations). Dhor-Kuldor slug parity fix confirmed: /api/nations/images returns 'dhor-kuldor' (not 'dhor-khuldor') and mobile World tab now loads Dhor-Kuldor cities (89 cities) via nation-card-dhor-kuldor. Full mobile RP entry flow works from previously-empty cities on both Dhor-Kuldor/Emberhold and Ammeonon/Amberport (location-card-* → rp-screen).

mobile.Dhor-Kuldor nation -> cities: 89 city-card-* items (previously broken by slug mismatch)

seed_data_creation: None - the repair endpoint had already been run on preview per E1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix is fully verified. Note for future testing: web CityDetail lazy-loads location cards via IntersectionObserver, so scroll the page to bottom before counting [data-testid^='location-card-']. Web route is /nations/:nation/:citySlug (not /cities/). Mobile Expo web preview is at https://npc-economy-preview.expo.preview.emergentagent.com and uses testID (renders as data-testid). Login field on mobile is a single 'Enter' button.
rca of the issue: Two-part root cause: (1) canon-city seed added city records to /api/cities but did NOT seed active RP locations, leaving ~15 cities across ammeonon/dhor-kuldor/veiled-realms with an empty locations collection -> UI shows 'No Locations Yet'. (2) The nations collection had the outlier slug 'dhor-khuldor' while cities/locations used 'dhor-kuldor'; web has a hardcoded slug list so it was mostly unaffected, but mobile navigates using the slug returned by /api/nations/images, so tapping the Dhor-Kuldor nation card fetched cities under the wrong slug and returned empty. Fix (POST /api/admin/repair-world-locations, already executed on preview) normalises the nation slug to 'dhor-kuldor' and idempotently seeds a 4-location starter set (Town Square, Hearth tavern, Market Row, Gate; all is_active + is_rp_enabled) for any city with zero active locations. All verifications pass.
